description: This file is the main activity class for an Android weather application, handling UI interactions, network requests, location permissions, and app update prompts.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: Main activity class managing user interface, location permissions, network requests, weather data display, and app update checks.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets up UI bindings, checks for updates, and sets listeners.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles results from speech recognition intent.

methods.name: setNavigationBarColor
methods.description: Sets the color of the device navigation bar.

methods.name: setUpDaysRecyclerView
methods.description: Sets up the RecyclerView to display daily weather forecast.

methods.name: listeners
methods.description: Sets event listeners for UI interactions such as search, refresh, and voice input.

methods.name: setRefreshLayoutColor
methods.description: Configures the color scheme for the refresh layout.

methods.name: searchCity
methods.description: Initiates weather data retrieval based on user-entered city name.

methods.name: getDataUsingNetwork
methods.description: Obtains location via GPS or permissions, then fetches weather data.

methods.name: setLatitudeLongitudeUsingCity
methods.description: Fetches geographic coordinates for a city name.

methods.name: getTodayWeatherInfo
methods.description: Retrieves current weather data for a specified location.

methods.name: updateUI
methods.description: Updates the UI components with the latest weather data.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Converts day names to localized strings.

methods.name: hideProgressBar
methods.description: Hides loading indicator and shows main layout.

methods.name: hideMainLayout
methods.description: Shows loading indicator, hides main content.

methods.name: checkConnection
methods.description: Verifies internet connectivity and triggers data retrieval.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles the result of location permission requests.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Checks network connection when activity resumes.

methods.name: checkUpdate
methods.description: Checks for app updates and prompts if available.
